description: This script encodes firmware files for MOXA IW devices by adding custom headers, encrypting the data with a XOR operation, and handling multiple partitions within the firmware. It provides command-line interface options for input/output files and device-specific parameters.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Data class representing a firmware partition with a name and size.

methods.name: bytes xor(data: bytes)
methods.description: Performs an XOR encryption on byte data using a cycle of a passphrase.

methods.name: bytes add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
methods.description: Adds a firmware header containing metadata, CRC, and offsets to the firmware data.

methods.name: bytes add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int)
methods.description: Adds a file header to a data segment with filename, size, CRC, and other metadata.

methods.name: int crc(data: bytes, init_val: int)
methods.description: Calculates a CRC32 checksum of the provided data with an initial value.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the reading, partitioning, header addition, encryption, and writing of the firmware file.

ctags.name: add_file_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int) -> bytes:$/

ctags.name: add_fw_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int,$/
ctags.signature: (data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
